verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for a cloud data warehouse, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an llms.txt file or docs written for agents. The MCP Toolbox server, Gemini-in-BigQuery features and the bq CLI belong to other stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
